name: hao-navigator-modular
description: HAO Navigator — a dependency-free, static explorer for the Higher Airspace Operations (HAO) dataset: vehicle classes, design flight paths, cross-FIR ground tracks, ATS interactions, CNS and equipage requirements, gaps in ICAO provisions, the job cards behind them, GANP/GATMOC alignment, a BFO-conformant ontology and a faceted taxonomy. Modular data build: one file per collection under data/parts/, assembled at load time by js/data-registry.js.
author: Yuri Fattah

scripts.check: node --check js/sanitize.js && node --check js/data-registry.js && node --check js/app.js && node --check js/flightpath.js && node --check js/planview.js && node --check js/roadmap.js && node --check js/heatmap.js && node --check js/ontology.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run check:data && npm run validate && npm run test:roundtrip
